hardGates.body: Do NOT proceed without an explicit topic, voice anchor, and book mode declared by the user. STOP and ask.
Do NOT begin chapter drafting until the narrative skeleton passes all pre-draft validation gates. STOP and fix the skeleton.
Do NOT begin chapter drafting until every load-bearing claim carries a verifier verdict. STOP and emit CLAIMS_UNVERIFIED.
Never draft chapters in parallel. STOP and draft sequentially so each chapter knows what came before.
Never emit a figure whose layout is scattered or free-form. STOP and re-spec as a structured layout.
Never invoke the Artifact tool. STOP and write output to the filesystem as PDF only.
Never produce the final PDF from a path other than rendered HTML. STOP and reroute through the HTML renderer.
Do NOT emit BOOK_SHIPPED unless every claim is verified, all 8 continuity gates pass, and the post-render verifier passes. STOP and emit the appropriate failure verdict.

gateFunctions.question: Has the user named topic, voice anchor, and book mode?
Does every load-bearing claim resolve to a `verified` verdict?
Did all 6 pre-draft skeleton validation gates pass?
Is chapter N fully drafted and its threads registered in the bible?
Is this layout one of the four permitted families: hierarchy, sequence, matrix, or table?
Did all 8 continuity gates pass and are all endnotes assembled?
Did the PDF originate exclusively from the HTML renderer, did every continuity gate pass, and is every claim verified?
Am I about to invoke the Artifact tool?

antiPatternFirstSentence: "I can write the chapters without building the narrative skeleton first, and the prose is fluent enough that the claims don't need independent verification."
checklistSteps: Confirm topic, voice anchor, and book mode with the user.
Decompose the topic into research themes.
Spawn one research subagent per theme and collect their markdown drafts.
Extract every load-bearing claim into a claims ledger and run the verification sidecar.
Build the architecture (chapter skeleton with entry/exit beliefs, concept cards, argument DAG).
Build the thread registry and transition contracts.
Validate the skeleton against 6 pre-draft gates.
Draft chapters sequentially, growing the bible during drafting.
Run the 8-gate continuity review with a separate agent.
Assemble per-chapter endnotes with clickable source URLs.
Assemble the HTML document and print to PDF via headless browser.
